subject: Pricing: Can Redwood match CloudScale for GreenBridge?
messages:
From: Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@greenbridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@greenbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing: Can Redwood match CloudScale for GreenBridge?

Hi Monica,

Quick note — we've been running a parallel evaluation and CloudScale has given us a fairly aggressive commercial (per-token rate and a sizable onboarding credit) that would tilt our math unless Redwood can come closer.

High level:
- Current usage (prod): ~3B tokens/month (inference + small batch embedding jobs)
- Forecast: +40% over next 12 months if latency stays under 150ms p95
- CloudScale offer: 18% lower per-token list than Redwood + $60k onboarding credit + 3 months free for dedicated pool setup

We're big fans of Redwood's runtime performance and the unified deployment story, but finance asked me to surface whether you can match or provide an equivalent concession (credits or term pricing) so we can keep the vendor consolidated.

What would you be willing to do on: 1) per-token match, 2) onboarding credit, and 3) migration support (sequence for dedicated pool setup)? I can share the CloudScale quote as an attachment — attaching that now.

Thanks,
Ethan Wallace
VP, Cloud Engineering | GreenBridge Retail
ethan.wallace@greenbridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: cloudscale_proposal_20260915.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing: Can Redwood match CloudScale for GreenBridge?

Folks — forwarding GreenBridge's ask. They sent the CloudScale quote and want a match on per-token + onboarding credit. Key details in Ethan's note above: ~3B tokens/mo today, +40% forecast, p95 latency constraint ~150ms.

My thinking: we want to protect margin but also avoid an unnecessary replacement. Options to consider (ranked):
1) Match per-token for the first 6 months for the specific workload tier they cited (realtime + batch) + $75k onboarding credit tied to a 12-month committed spend.
2) Offer a blended discount schedule (20% first 6 months, 10% subsequent for the year) plus professional services credit to accelerate migration.
3) If we can't match on price, offer technical concessions: guaranteed priority on Dedicated pool capacity (SLA) + migration engineering support + staged billing credits.

Questions for Aditya: what does a 20% off that bucket do to target gross margin? Also need input from Solutions Eng on whether we can commit to the dedicated pool and timeline (3–4 week onboard). Marissa — please prepare a short competitive comparison (terms, SLA, egress, data handling differences) we can share with the buyer.

I will draft an external-facing, concise counter once we have numbers.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing: Can Redwood match CloudScale for GreenBridge?

Thanks for the context. Quick calc: if GreenBridge is at ~3B tokens/mo, annualized base is ~36B tokens.

Scenario impacts (back-of-envelope):
- Match per-token for 6 months: assuming CloudScale is ~18% lower, matching for the first 6 months reduces expected ARR by ~9% for year 1 on that book — margin hit depends on model mix and quantization. Estimated gross margin drop: ~6–9 p.p.
- $75k onboarding credit + 12-month commit: better because credit is one-time; ~$75k on a likely $1.1–1.5M ARR deal is manageable and keeps unit economics intact.
- Blended discount (20% first 6 months, 10% next 6): similar ARR impact to matching per-token but smoother.

Recommendation: offer option B — $75k onboarding credit + a 15% per-token rebate applied retroactively for the first 90 days if they hit committed throughput thresholds (this aligns incentives). Guarantee dedicated pool priority and a 3-week migration window with Solutions Eng (we can commit to that for enterprise onboard).

If they push hard for match, we can do a temporary per-token match for 90 days but require a 12-month minimum commitment and a commitment to migrate within 6 weeks.

Marissa — can you confirm SLA language and any gating on dedicated pool reservation? I want this cleared from infra before we commit publicly.

-Aditya
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@greenbridge.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: Can Redwood match CloudScale for GreenBridge?

Ethan — thanks for the note and for sharing the CloudScale proposal. We appreciate the candid ask and GreenBridge's desire to stay consolidated where it makes sense. Below is a concise counter that balances economics and a fast, low-risk migration path.

What Redwood can offer GreenBridge:
- Pricing: We will match CloudScale's per-token rate for the specific workload tier they've quoted for an initial 90-day period, contingent on a 12-month minimum commitment signed before migration kickoff.
- Credit: $75,000 onboarding & migration credit applied against month 1–3 invoices to offset migration setup (networking, dedicated pool provisioning, test harnessing).
- Performance & availability: dedicated pool priority for the first 6 months with a documented SLA target of p95 < 150ms for your production traffic (subject to the usual RFC checks).
- Migration support: dedicated Solutions Eng team, weekly migration workshop, and a runbook. Target timeline: pilot in 2–3 weeks, production migration within 6 weeks of kickoff.
- Measurement: we'll run the migration together and measure latency/cost with shared dashboards; rebates apply if committed throughput thresholds are met.

Attachments: I've attached a short comparison and an onboarding workbook to make next steps clearer. If this is acceptable, we can send a DocuSign with the 12-month commitment and schedule the workshop.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the 90-day match + $75k credit (reply to this thread).
2) Sign the commitment (DocuSign link included).
3) Kickoff migration workshop (we'll propose calendar times).

Happy to jump on a call with you and Priya later today if that's helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Redwood_vs_CloudScale_Terms_Comparison.pdf, GreenBridge_Redo_Onboarding_Costs.xlsx
